finding.title: The private ignored worker fails canonical blanket ignored-test CI
finding.trigger: Canonical debug/release experimental reference checks pass -- --ignored without MIXER_DIFFERENTIAL_BRANCH_CASE. libtest independently selects both ignored functions, including isolated_branch_table_case.
finding.observed: Existing producer binary with the case variable explicitly removed panics at line 110 with NotPresent; child exit 101 and one failed test.
finding.why_producer_missed_it: The producer runs --ignored --exact nested_branch_table_matches_node; only that parent sets the variable for its child processes, so the standalone worker is filtered out.
finding.requested_change: Make the worker entry safe under canonical blanket --ignored discovery while keeping the dispatcher and all sixteen actual cases exercised; verify the blanket ignored invocation as well as the exact dispatcher invocation.
finding.feature_scope: Reproduced in the existing experimental-swift-reactor-only debug binary. The canonical combined-feature failure follows from the same unconditionally compiled environment unwrap; combined-feature CI was not rerun.

verified_positive_evidence.module_construction: Reviewed the exact hashed byte generator, Fixture serializer, signed LEB constants, WASI import signatures/order and exported function indices. Helper has three typed blocks and br_table vector [0,1,2,3] with default depth1; unreachable follows the branch. _start keeps address32 on its operand stack across call35, stores helper output at32, and fd_write emits exactly 4/8 bytes via a data-segment iovec at0.
verified_positive_evidence.oracle_independence: The same original bytes go to Node WebAssembly.validate/Module/Instance and Mixer validation/execution. The JS import stub observes fd_write only, copies memory bytes and writes nwritten; every other imported call throws. Both output paths must equal the independently specified expected bytes, giving transitive Node/Mixer parity.
verified_positive_evidence.fail_closed_cases: Node absence, invalid modules, unexpected imports, nonzero Node exit, validation errors, guest execution failures and output mismatches fail assertions. No unsupported-case conditional skips occur within the explicitly selected corpus.
verified_positive_evidence.cleanup_source_assessment: The command dispatcher runs actual owned execution, consumes frame/growth state, rejects nonempty frame/value/control/pin cleanup, drops state/cache/WASI/proof/header storage, then returns finish_owned_cleanup observations. The test checks cleanup_completed, actual after_cleanup, fourteen current counters, live_tickets and cleanup_invariant before semantic assertions.
verified_positive_evidence.process_isolation: Parent constructs no runtime. Each exact child constructs one consuming runtime after Node has exited and wait_with_output has collected its pipes. First failure stops the parent loop; no second runtime is constructed in a child.
verified_positive_evidence.producer_process_custody: Producer driver/read receipts show build/corpus direct children reaped, owned groups observed absent, and parent log descriptors closed. These are retained producer observations, not fresh reviewer probes.
verified_positive_evidence.cargo_discovery: Cargo.toml uses default automatic integration-test discovery; producer compiler artifact identifies this file as a test target. File-level cfg removes tests without experimental-swift-reactor. With that feature both tests are ignored in ordinary test runs. Canonical combined-feature --ignored commands select both, exposing R1634-1.
verified_positive_evidence.receipt_claim_accuracy: The sixteen-case host-development parity and cleanup claims are supported by matching source and raw output; acceptance still requires fixing the canonical ignored-worker entry failure.

limitations: R1620 recorded only debug experimental-swift-reactor mode (stream-validation and swift-wasi transitively enabled); release, combined feature and default-feature corpus behavior were not executed by producer or reviewer.

Generated module construction was traced from exact source/fixture bytes and correlated with successful Node assertions in captured output; no standalone generated .wasm dump was retained or independently rerun.

This covers one nested branch-table shape at both integer widths, not loops, arbitrary label vectors, multi-value labels, malformed-module corpus, randomized differential coverage, or full Swift artifacts.
Review discriminator intentionally fails before module construction, Node launch and consuming VM execution; it does not supply a fresh parity or ledger run.
No performance, default/resource feasibility, native/device, FieldLog, database, published-package, security-release or GA qualification; W07/W08 and GA remain open.

ownership_and_cleanup.index_artifact_check: Not applicable: no staging or Git mutation.
